title: Playtopia Proxy rule
description: A single traffic-modification rule. Rules are evaluated in insertion order; every enabled rule whose match conditions all hold is applied. Match fields that don't apply to the rule's target are ignored (e.g. 'method' on a ws rule, 'event' on a rest rule). A rule with an empty 'match' is a wildcard and applies to every message of its target.

id.description: Unique rule identifier. Setting a rule with an existing id replaces it.

enabled.description: Disabled rules are kept but never applied.

target.description: 'rest' = Supabase REST/auth HTTP calls (/rest/v1, /auth/v1). 'ws' = Realtime WebSocket frames (/realtime/v1/websocket).

match.description: Conditions; all present fields must match. All optional.

path_contains.description: Substring of the request path including query string, e.g. '/rest/v1/profiles'. For ws rules this is the WebSocket URL path.

event.description: WS only. Exact Phoenix event name, e.g. 'phx_join', 'phx_reply', 'broadcast', 'postgres_changes', 'presence_diff'.

direction.description: 'client' = sent by the game (REST request / client->server frame). 'server' = sent by Supabase (REST response / server->client frame). Omit to match both.

contains.description: Substring that must appear in the body / frame text (checked before modification).

action.description: What to do with matching messages.

type.description: 'replace_json_field' sets an existing JSON field. 'string_replace' replaces every occurrence of a substring. 'drop' discards the frame (ws only).

path.description: replace_json_field: keys/indices from the JSON root. '*' matches every array element / object value. Only existing fields are replaced. For Phoenix v2 array frames, a leading 'payload' (or 'topic', 'event', 'ref', 'join_ref') is mapped to the right array index, so ['payload', ...] works for both v1 and v2.

value.description: replace_json_field: the new value (any JSON type).
